data.one_liner: Mocks for Firebase Storage to write unit tests.
data.what_it_does: Provides mock implementations for Firebase Storage, allowing developers to write unit tests that involve Firebase Storage without connecting to a real backend. It supports functionalities like putting data, getting download URLs, listing files, and updating metadata.
use_when: You are writing unit tests for code that uses Firebase Storage
You need to test file upload, download, or deletion logic without a live Firebase connection
avoid_when: You are performing integration or end-to-end testing with a real backend
Your project does not use Firebase Storage
strengths: Enables unit testing for Firebase Storage features
Maintains compatibility with official firebase_storage package versions
Implements many core features including putData, getDownloadURL, and listAll
weaknesses: Mock behavior may not cover 100% of edge cases present in the real Firebase Storage backend
